opis: The sunny kitchen from the reference picture (the same wallpaper, window, wall clock, shelves, mint fridge and dresser), warm afternoon light. Across the top of the kitchen hangs a GARLAND of small triangle paper flags on a string, alternating RED, YELLOW, RED, YELLOW all along. In the FRONT, a joyful little kitchen band facing us: the FOX beats an upside-down cooking POT with a wooden spoon; the SQUIRREL taps a teaspoon on a white CUP; the OWL sways and sings with her eyes closed; the ROE DEER dances in the middle, one front hoof raised, smiling proudly. BEHIND them, at the wooden kitchen table set with cups and small plates, sit FOUR GROWN-UP animals, the parents - a big grown-up fox, a grown-up squirrel, a big grown-up owl and a grown-up roe deer - all CLAPPING their paws, wings and hooves and smiling widely. A few little musical notes float in the air. Happy, warm and proud.
